name: Horizon Zero Dawn (Remastered / Complete Edition)
native_kbm_note: PS5 version (Remastered) has no keyboard/mouse gameplay support; KBM controls exist only in the PC port. No source found listing KBM for the PS4/PS5 versions; the sequel is confirmed controller-only on PS (windowsreport.com/horizon-forbidden-west-keyboard-and-mouse).
notes: PC MOUSE1 is light melee (R1) when not aiming and fire (R2) while aiming; mapped to R2 because firing the bow is the core action, so MOUSE1 without aiming gives heavy melee (R2). Light melee lands on R (PC reload-while-aiming = R1 on PS5). PC heavy melee is LSHIFT+MOUSE1; with this map MOUSE1 alone already does heavy melee. LSHIFT is sprint (L3) and also Concentration while aiming on PC; on PS5 Concentration is R3 while aiming, so it is not reproduced (LSHIFT kept as L3). Show HUD (PC H hold) is a touchpad swipe/touch on PS5 and cannot be sent as a button, omitted. Menu sub-pages (I/M/K/O/J/N) all open the touchpad menu on PS5; mapped to TOUCHPAD. Quick weapon keys 1-4, walk toggle (CAPSLOCK) and manual save (G) have no PS5 button equivalent. Remastered PS5 keeps the original layout.
